title: Senate cuts P97B in DPWH projects over non-compliance
summary: The Senate Committee on Finance has removed P97 billion worth of projects from the proposed 2027 budget of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) for failing to meet technical…

blocks.text: The Senate Committee on Finance has removed P97 billion worth of projects from the proposed 2027 budget of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) for failing to meet technical requirements.
In a 24 Oras report on Saturday, Senate Finance Committee chairperson JV Ejercito said the panel cut funding for 295 projects that reportedly failed to comply with the requirements.
The funding for 36 DPWH buildings and other projects was also removed following the implementation of stricter requirements.
Ejercito said he hoped the remaining district projects would help spur economic growth.
The Senate's review came after watchdog group People's Budget Coalition (PBC) flagged around P1 trillion worth of questionable items in the House-approved General Appropriations Bill for 2027.
House Speaker Faustino "Bojie" Dy III has backed calls for greater transparency in the national budget and vowed to make more budget documents available to the public.— Jean Mangaluz/MCG, GMA News
